interpretations: For films with `replacement_cost >= 20.99`, compute each rating’s average `rental_rate / rental_duration` over nonmissing ratios; take the unweighted mean of the nonmissing rating averages; if that mean exists, return each rating whose average exceeds it, with the rating, its unrounded average, and its unrounded difference from the overall mean.
queries:
WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT rating, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - overall_mean AS difference
FROM rating_averages
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE overall_mean IS NOT NULL
  AND avg_ratio > overall_mean
